narrative:
HTB employs 458 people, up from 421 a year ago, across origination, savings operations, technology and data, credit, risk and finance. All customer service is in-house by design — HTB does not outsource its savings service.

The roster is weighted to origination (85 BDMs, underwriters and completions staff in mortgages and bridging, 55 relationship directors in development and wholesale finance) and savings operations (85). Technology, data and change has 75 people delivering the multi-year digitisation and AI programme.

Key risk: two senior development finance directors with £140M of relationships are flagged as departure risks.

signals.title: Cost-income ratio improved to 48.8%
signals.excerpt: Administrative expenses £84.6M; FTEs 421 → 458; multi-year investment programme in digitisation and AI.
